title: Canon of the Returning Blow
summary: A canon on taking the full force of a blow and passing it back along the same line with weight added.

title: The Open Ledger Canon
summary: A canon on spreading the qi field as a ledger in which each foe's debts show plainly and drag at their limbs.

title: Manual of Even Measure
summary: A court manual of exact measure that weighs a harm done and answers it with a blow of precisely that weight.

title: The Reckoning of Seven Deeds
summary: A reckoning that reads the last seven deeds of a foe in the qi field and returns each one as a blow.

title: Manual of the Sworn Debt
summary: A manual of the wind-sworn who treat a debt as an oath: the user binds a foe to a debt and rides down to collect it.

title: Treatise on the Unforgotten Harm
summary: A treatise on an old wrong that is never forgotten by the qi and returns to its doer long after the wrong was done.
